split_rule: Shot-level random partition of a shared shot pool: train uses all slices from 5828 shots; validation contains 728 shots / 21147 slices; test contains 730 shots / 21350 slices. Train, validation, and test shots are disjoint. Training fractions are nested shot subsets (1 < 5 < 10 < 25 < 50 < 100 percent).

phase_composition.train: All training slices from the shot subset selected for each data fraction

notes: Training run manifests use subset_run_real_{f}pct and include all validation rows; only training-phase rows are used as training samples.
